newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's EDP valued at 1,000-1,700 bln esc - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's EDP valued at 1,000-1,700 bln esc - paper.

text.p: Electricity company EDP- Electricidade de Portugal, slated for privatisation in 1997, has been valued at between 1,000 and 1,700 billion escudos, sources involved in the valuation told Diario de Noticias newspaper.
The valuation range incorporates preliminary estimates submitted by some banking consortia to the Finance Ministry, the newspaper reported.
One consortium will be chosen from three by the end of this year to organise the privatisation of some 25-30 percent of EDP's holding company, it added.
The three consortia are: Banco Cisf, Lehman Brothers and Kleinwort Benson; Banco Essi, Merrill Lynch, SBC Warburg and UBS; and Banco Portugues de Investimento, Goldman Sachs and Rothschild.
